subject: website
name: Thurin.id Docs
summary: Thurin.id Docs, a Docsify documentation site, open source (Apache-2.0) in thurinlabs/docs. It runs no third-party code and loads only its own files. Its Check a key demo asks ethereum.publicnode.com about a key owner only when the visitor presses Check, which the page says beside the button: an optional part started knowingly, so it is Level 4 but not private.

connections.name: Ethereum RPC for the demo (ethereum.publicnode.com)
connections.note: Only when Check is pressed in the Check a key demo.
